item.name: Download PDF - returns signed URL as JSON

request.description:
GET /api/admin/reports/export/{id}/download

Returns:
- 200: Streams file and deletes after
- 403: Not authorized
- 404: Export not found
- 409: Export not ready yet
- 410: Export expired
